subject: Harpoon-11B serialized variant: staging serialization checks & pin request
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Paul Kim <paul@satori.ai>, Satori Labs Engineering <e2e-ops@satori.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Harpoon-11B serialized variant: staging serialization checks & pin request

Team — looping everyone in for intake on Satori Labs' Harpoon-11B (serialized kv-cache variant). They shipped us a quantized package that uses a custom serializer (packed_kv_v1) and a tokenizer build that diverges from our tokenizer v2.0.

Ask: Can we run a short compatibility run in staging (sanity + tokenizer parity + prefix caching validation) and grant a temporary "version pin" for this variant through the initial canary (3-day window)? Product would like the variant pinned so traffic during canary doesn't automatically fallback to a non-serialized variant; they'd prefer controlled rollback.

Quick context: Satori expects to go live with the variant for a pilot starting July 6. They provided the intake artifacts and a short test prompt set. We need to confirm:
- Tokenizer parity (v2.1 changes vs our v2.0) — are there determinism risks?
- Runtime kernel support for packed_kv_v1 (NVIDIA A100 + Ampere optimized kernels)
- Telemetry hooks for KV cache misses + token alignment during canary

Attachments: harpoon_intake_checklist.pdf (intake answers), harpoon_tokenizer_diff.patch, harpoon-test-prompts.txt
Links: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INFER-2274 (intake ticket), s3://redwood-models/harpoon/11b/weights.tar.lz4

I propose the following owners: Marcus for runtime/kernel check; Laura for rollout window and telemetry configuration; David for security & audit log needs. Aditya — can you validate the tokenizer diff and run a quick tokenization parity script?

Thanks — Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Product Ops, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: harpoon_intake_checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Harpoon-11B serialized variant: staging serialization checks & pin request

Thanks Steph — quick notes after a first pass on the package (I pulled the S3 artifact):
- packed_kv_v1: looks like a compacted KV layout; we have partial support in the runtime but not the optimized path. We'll need a small kernel shim (likely CUDA-level adjustments) to avoid a large perf penalty.
- Quantization: the weights are 4-bit QAT with a custom scale table. That will require an ingest-time transform to our canonical quant format; I can script that but need a 2-hour slot on a dev GPU to validate numerical parity.
- Tokenizer: Aditya, the diff shows changes to byte pair merging and an updated CLS token handling (v2.1). If we do a blind pin to the serialized variant and the tokenization differs, you'll see misaligned KV lookups in hot prefixes.

Questions for the group:
1) Is Satori willing to accept a provisional perf hit while we land the optimized kernel?
2) What exact pin policy do we want? Pin-through-canary (3 days) or pin-until-rollback (until we flip a feature flag)?

I can start the ingest transform on Tues morning if someone books a dev node.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Runtime Engineering
[Attachment: harpoon_tokenizer_diff.patch (patch)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 13:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Harpoon-11B serialized variant: staging serialization checks & pin request

Looping in the rollout considerations:
- Window: July 6 pilot start is tight. If Marcus needs kernel work, we should push pilot start to July 9 to leave 48 hours for validation and canary warmup.
- Telemetry: we need token-aligned latency and a KV-miss metric exposed to the Console (route/model breakdown) for the canary. Devops can wire this but I need David to confirm log retention / audit flags for the ingest.
- Pin policy: recommend "pin-through-canary" (3-day fixed window) with automatic unpin if error rate > 0.5% or if KV-miss delta > 15% relative to baseline.

Finally, please ensure legal/security has the artifact hash. David — can you take that?

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Product — Model Ops
[Attachment: harpoon-test-prompts.txt (txt)]

From: Paul Kim <paul@satori.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Satori Labs Engineering <e2e-ops@satori.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Harpoon-11B serialized variant: staging serialization checks & pin request

Thanks for the quick review — really appreciate the attention to token parity. A few clarifications from our side: 
- We can supply a patch to fallback to a non-packed-kv path if the runtime reports an unsupported kernel; however, we were hoping to avoid a silent fallback during canary (hence the pin ask).
- We're OK delaying to July 9 if that reduces risk. We can also provide an optimized kernel from our engineers as a stopgap — Paul Bhatt (cc'd on e2e-ops) can share a CUDA artifact.
- Test prompts: included sample_user_convo and search-rewrite cases; feel free to augment.

Action items from Satori:
- Share tokenization test vectors (done).
- Provide artifact hash and signed metadata (will upload to the Jira ticket INFER-2274 by EOD).

Let us know whether you want us to open a shared dev node session for kernel debugging.

— Paul Kim
Head of Platform, Satori Labs
paul@satori.ai

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paul Kim <paul@satori.ai>, Satori Labs Engineering <e2e-ops@satori.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Harpoon-11B serialized variant: staging serialization checks & pin request

Thanks everyone — quick summary / owners and next steps so we have single source of truth: 
- Marcus: schedule dev GPU slot Tues 7/6 AM to run ingest transform & validate numerics. If kernel shim needed, coordinate with Paul (Satori) to get their CUDA artifact.
- Aditya: run token parity script against harpoon-test-prompts.txt; post parity report in INFER-2274 by EOD 7/2.
- Laura: configure telemetry hooks (token-aligned latency, KV-miss metric) and set alert thresholds (0.5% error rate, >15% KV-miss delta).
- David: capture artifact hash and confirm retention/audit flags; confirm whether SOC2 evidence is required for pilot artifacts and echo back by 7/2.
- Satori: please upload signed metadata and the optimized kernel (if available) to INFER-2274; we'll collect and link in the ticket.

Decision for now: move pilot start to July 9; tentatively approve a pin-through-canary for 72 hours starting at canary launch, subject to parity & telemetry pass. If any owner sees a blocking issue, flag in INFER-2274 and we'll pause.

I'll update the ticket and send a short Slack ping to the infra on-call when the dev node is claimed.

— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Product Ops, Redwood Inference
